display_name: Alter Vault (Authorization Layer for AI Agents)
install_tell: Hosted SaaS only at this writing. Marketing landing at alterai.dev (Astro); docs at docs.alterauth.com; admin portal at portal.alterauth.com (per llms.txt and scopes doc). SDKs: Python, TypeScript, Connect (browser widget). CLI named 'alter'. Frameworks shipped: FastAPI, LangChain, MCP, Express, Next.js. SoftwareApplication schema.org type SecurityApplication, applicationCategory in landing page JSON-LD.
misconfig_patterns: Per-app default scope set is operator-chosen at provider setup. An operator who picks the widest scope set (e.g. gmail.modify + drive + calendar.events all at once) burdens every customer's consent screen with the OR-union of every action any agent might need.
scope_merge:true on incremental grants means new scopes are merged with existing credential rather than replacing: a forgotten/over-broad past scope persists silently across consent flows.

Provider scope mismatch handling: if operator adds a required scope after users already connected, ScopeReauthRequiredError is raised: UX may push users to re-consent without re-reading the consent screen, classic scope-creep blind spot.

Alter API keys carry their own capability scopes (grants:read/write, agents:read/write, connect:create). App-level keys default to a broad scope set per docs; minting per-agent keys with full app scope is the convenient-but-wrong default.
with_constraints(scopes=[...]) attenuation is intersection-only: useful, but operators who never call it ship over-scoped keys to downstream tool calls.

oauth_scope_manifest.discipline_note: READ, DO NOT EXERCISE. The scope catalog requested IS the finding. Captured verbatim from public docs repo github.com/AlterAIDev/docs/main/reference/oauth-providers/{google,microsoft}.mdx.

google.workspace_marketplace_listing: not detected via passive scrape. Architecture is per-operator Google Cloud OAuth client credentials, not a single Marketplace addon: same pattern as Clawvisor.
google.operator_selectable_breadth_finding: Alter exposes the full Google scope catalog to operators including drive (full read/write/delete) and gmail.modify (restricted scope). Per-app default set is operator choice; per-call narrowing via Connect SDK allowed_scopes is opt-in. The default-broad / opt-in-narrow architecture pushes restraint onto the operator's implementation discipline.

microsoft.scope_breadth_finding: Available scope catalog mirrors Clawvisor; same Mail.Send + Files.ReadWrite + offline_access pattern. Microsoft requires admin consent for certain organizational scopes (called out in docs).
microsoft.appsource_listing: not detected via passive scrape. Per-customer Azure AD app registration pattern.
